sources.dataVersion: 2026 resource distribution; accepted GeoJSON collection is internally labelled 2025; currentness remains follow-up.
sources.scope: Published public-coordinate registry-map sheets for Okayama City (33201), not citywide completeness. SHP is the paired 2026 format in the same official CKAN package as the frozen GeoJSON endpoint. Geometry-only member is read live, attributes are never requested. Missing public-coordinate sheets remain gaps.

identity.recipe: Lowercase SHA-256 of the unchanged little-endian SHP geometry record content, excluding its 8-byte record framing. This includes geometry type, source-derived bbox, ring indices and every native double coordinate, with no row number or byte offset in the identity. Prefix with source ID + /native-shape-sha256-v1/. Identical native geometries deduplicate; source corrections/reordering of coordinates change references.
identity.reason: Native ID repeats across sheets; geometry-derived references avoid reading any DBF attributes. These are source geometry references, not legal parcel identifiers.

projection.operation: JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS V inverse Transverse Mercator to longitude,latitude on GRS80, used as geographic WGS84 display coordinates without fitted offset.
projection.uncertainty: JGD2011 epoch/datum transformation to WGS84 and external basemap alignment are not independently surveyed; second-pass follow-up.

jurisdiction.basis: First-party CKAN package aigid-moj-33201 is 岡山県-岡山市 and describes conversion of MOJ registry-office cadastral maps, public-coordinate sheets only.
